proves.claim: clause 1: with composeLanding a parent whose unfinished children are all slices passes the children guard, and an unfinished child that is not a slice still refuses CHILDREN_OPEN.

moves.submit.children-slices.why: Slices compose into the parent landing, so the guard must let them through without letting a plain child slip by (#12757).

proves.claim: clause 2: with composeLanding absent or false the children guard refuses exactly as before, and each snapshot child carries its slice flag.

moves.submit.children-slices-off.why: The setting is off by default, so the guard must not change for a project that has not turned it on (#12757).
